subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix channel dispatch broken in v2026.6.1 — TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'run')

question: Should this issue be closed only after durable stale Matrix install repair is proven for packaged npm/docker upgrades, or is a diagnostic-only Matrix guard acceptable for this report?
rationale: The remaining fix crosses plugin selection, doctor/update behavior, and upgrade compatibility; accepting a fail-fast diagnostic instead of pre-import repair is a maintainer product and upgrade-safety choice.

options.title: Require durable pre-import repair
options.body: Keep this issue open until doctor/update/plugin selection refreshes or disables stale official Matrix installs before gateway import and has packaged upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept diagnostic-only scope
options.body: Treat the Matrix handler guard as sufficient once it has real stale-install proof, while leaving durable upgrade repair to a separate follow-up.

options.title: Close after release proof
options.body: Close only if maintainers can point to v2026.6.11 or current-main package-acceptance artifacts that reproduce and repair this exact stale Matrix upgrade state.

recommendation.title: Require durable pre-import repair
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until doctor/update/plugin selection refreshes or disables stale official Matrix installs before gateway import and has packaged upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release/plugin-update history makes this the best available owner for deciding whether current shipped upgrade proof is sufficient.
